# <span id="aanchor114"></span> Volume Editor

## Grid Legend

The Grid Legend contains an overview of color and alarm state codes used in the Volume Editor.

The character codes are set per flow data (periodic) record. The information displayed on the Daily and Monthly tab is from meter rollups; therefore, character codes are only displayed on the Flow Data Periodic tab and not on the daily or monthly tabs. However, color codes are available from all three display tabs (Periodic, Daily, and Monthly).

<div class="procedure">

To access the Grid Legend:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Volume Editor**.
2.  Click the **View** menu.
3.  Select **Grid Legend**.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Character Codes">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Character Codes</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Character Codes">



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 569;height: 352;" />

- **P** - PPA Approved
- **±** - Pending Approval
- **C** - Character Change
- **A** - Analysis Change
- **O** - Equipment Change
- **AE** - Auto Estimated Data
- **I** - Meter Status Inactive
- **U** - Has Ultrasonic Record
- **R** - Has Prove or Test Report
- **OA** - Override Analysis
- **N** - Notes
- **ACBI** - Auto Created Batch Record
- **DST** - Daylight Saving Time Change. If a user edits data in such a way that a spring forward periodic record(s) is no longer missing, the DST flag is reset and a new hour can now be flagged as a DST spring forward missing data as long as it is within the applicable spring forward day.
- **V** - Virtual Batch
- **S** - Soft Close
